extraction.notes: Partial provider extraction: these cards cover Senior Music only, the program supplied in full. The official camps-by-type directory lists many additional programs that still require individual-page research; they are not excluded under the camp rule. The homepage says '2027 Camps Coming in December'; no specific registration opening date was verified. The homepage's 'Register by Dec. 31 SAVE 20%' has no explicit year and was not converted into a 2027 milestone. Registration is currently closed.

cards.name: Senior Music
cards.description: Campers choose instrumental, vocal or composition tracks and participate in private instruction, rehearsals, workshops and final recitals and concerts. Daily devotions and Bible challenges are included.

prices.label: Overnight Camp; additional $20 registration fee per camper, not per camp

availability.text: This camp is closed for this year. Check back again next year!

lunch.text: Lunch will be served in our dining common in an all-you-can-eat buffet style.

transportation.text: We offer complimentary shuttle service to and from the GSP International Airport as well as the Greenville Amtrak and Greyhound stations. You can request a shuttle on the online registration form.

cards.review_notes: Dates use 2026 from the homepage's 2026 camp heading and the program's 'As of Sept. 2026 and 2026 grads' eligibility statement. Rising grades represents September eligibility; 2026 graduates are also expressly eligible. The homepage's December announcement is provider-wide, not a confirmation of Senior Music's 2027 return. Audition instructions conflict: one section requires advance string videos while another describes Sunday chair-placement auditions.
